title: The Broken Oath
logline: A disillusioned guard breaks their sacred oath to steal a holy relic to pay for medical care, and needs a pilot to fight off their fanatical former comrades.

roles.description: Stoic, heavily scarred, wearing stripped-down ceremonial armor.
Zealous, uncompromising, views everything in absolute terms of holy and profane.
A fortress-monastery carved into an asteroid.
A heavily armored pursuit craft painted in holy colors.
The fanatic religious order controlling the system.

public_situation: Alarms ring across the {role:sacred_vault}. A priceless holy relic has been stolen by one of its own protectors.
private_truth: The guard stole the relic because their child is dying of a curable disease, and the priest refused to use church funds to pay for the medicine.

beats.public_change: The guard attempts to flee into the dead system, their ship trailing smoke.

missions.reason: The guard hires the pilot to deliver ferrite to patch their ship's failing engines so they can escape.
missions.private_fact: The guard admits they are bleeding heavily and can't fix the ship themselves.

beats.public_change: The priest rallies the remaining guards for a holy crusade to recover the relic.

missions.reason: The priest hires the pilot to scan the dead system to find the traitor's ion trail.
missions.private_fact: The fleeing guard stole the church relic to pawn it for life-saving medicine after the priest refused to release emergency funds.

beats.public_change: The guard patrol catches up to the traitor, preparing to execute them.

missions.reason: The guard begs the pilot to destroy the fanatical patrol so they can sell the relic and save their child.
missions.private_fact: The priest hails the pilot, offering absolution and church gold if they destroy the traitor instead.

player_choice.prompt: The patrol is destroyed. The guard is ready to jump. The priest offers church gold to kill the traitor.

options.label: Kill the guard and take the priest's gold

resolutions.summary: The guard escapes, sells the relic, and saves their child. The priest is humiliated, and the church's power wanes.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped a traitorous guard steal a holy relic to save their child.

resolutions.summary: The guard is killed, and the relic is returned to the vault. The guard's child dies. The pilot is paid in holy gold.
The patrol captures the guard. They are stripped of their rank and permanently exiled. The relic is secured, and the child dies.

loose_threads.detail: The "holy relic" is actually a piece of advanced terraforming tech from the lost colonials, not divine at all.
The guard notes that the priest recently spent millions on a luxury yacht while the faithful starved.

radio_hooks: {role:fanatical_priest} calls for a crusade against the traitor.

voice_direction.disillusioned_guard: Heavy, exhausted, speaks entirely without hope.
